headword: {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}
gloss: men and women of all ages; everyone

definitions.gloss: men and women of all ages, everyone regardless of age or gender
definitions.explanation: A four-character compound meaning people of all ages and genders — literally "old, young, male, female." Used to emphasize that something includes or applies to everyone without exception.

examples.japanese: {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{愛|あい}される→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a film loved by people of all ages.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{参加|さんか}できる→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Anyone can participate in this festival, regardless of age or gender.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だ。
examples.english: This game is designed to be enjoyable by people of all ages and genders, and the controls are simple.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The reading ろうにゃくなんにょ uses the Buddhist-influenced pronunciation にゃく (for {若|わか}) and にょ (for ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧). This is a set four-character compound — the reading cannot be changed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず (regardless of age or gender)
- {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (popular with everyone)
- {老若男女|ろうにゃくなんにょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (people of all ages gather)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: anyone (simpler, more casual)
- ⟦{万人|ばんにん}→万人：08110_bannin⟧: everyone, all people (literary)
